system.description:
Activate Reaction

Trigger You regain Hit Points from a spell with the Healing trait

Frequency 1/day

The rune resembles a burning candle whose flame never quite touches the wick.

After the healing is resolved, reduce either Fatigued or Sickened by 1. If the triggering spell required at least 4 PP, you may instead reduce Dazed or Weakened by 1, or 6 PP Injured by 1.

The rune does not increase the amount of HP restored.

Inscribed onto armour.

On the sheet: Offered after a Healing-trait spell heals you, once a day: which condition to reduce, from those the spell's PP reached and you hold.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
